dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, how's the situation on Yashiori Island now?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: We've begun reconstruction and redevelopment efforts in cooperation with Sangonomiya. This will, of course, damage our imports of Jade Steel, but there's nothing to be done.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: After all, we've ignored their humiliation for so long as we exploited an entity that they considered divine...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: I'm sorry. I'm afraid this as far as I can go without speaking out of turn.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, the things that happened during the war did not surprise me at all. Were my father at the head of our troops, I suspect that his methods would have been crueler still...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: Indeed, he would probably see it as what ought to be done.
